title: NASA DART mission hits Dimorphos

tellings.quote: I looked at the NASA dart mission and you know that was a spacecraft uh I think was knocking into Dorphice
DART program aimed to prove that humans can deflect asteroids with satellites and prevent Earth impact
tellings.difference: Frames it as proving that humans can deflect asteroids and spans 2021-2022.
tellings.link_reason: The same NASA DART mission that struck Dimorphos to test asteroid deflection.

plain: In 2022 a NASA spacecraft, sent on a mission called DART, is said to have deliberately crashed into Dimorphos, a small moon circling an asteroid called Didymos, to show that humans could push an asteroid off course and keep it from hitting Earth. Michels brings this up himself in two conversations, once with the author Graham Hancock in 2022, where he describes it as a programme "aimed to prove that humans can deflect asteroids" and places it across 2021 and 2022, and again with the researcher Randall Carlson in 2025, where he recalls it as "a spacecraft knocking into" the little moon. He tells it as something he looked into, and it matters to him because it suggests people now have a way to defend the planet from space rocks.
